## Published Research Paper
- Title: "Exploring the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Convenient and Accessible Healthcare Support Systems"
- Author: Ujwal Singh
- Date: February 2026
- Repository: TechRxiv (powered by IEEE)
- DOI: 10.36227/techrxiv.177006061.17458864/v1
- Full Article URL: https://www.techrxiv.org/doi/full/10.36227/techrxiv.177006061.17458864/v1
- Practical Implementation: MediSoul (https://cure23.vercel.app/)
- Core Findings: AI in healthcare functions as an assistive decision-support, non-clinical triage, and patient guidance system while strictly preserving human doctor referral boundaries and ethical clinical safeguards.
